name: com.gamefactory.sdk
description: Unified game infrastructure SDK for the LaunchForge pipeline: Ads (AppLovin MAX / ironSource LevelPlay / Google AdMob standalone), Analytics (Firebase / Adjust), RemoteConfig, IAP (Unity IAP), User. EU/US channel roster (Meta, UnityAds, Vungle, Mintegral, Pangle, AmazonAPS, InMobi, Chartboost) covered via MAX mediation. Config-driven via gamefactory_config.json. Plug-and-play: conditional provider assemblies compile only when their SDK + scripting define are present.
